title: Watchdog calls any up ComfyUI with ours=no an 'orphaned GPU leak' (false CRITICAL) while a co-tenant holds the claim
evidence: live 2026-09-20 00:45Z: port 8188 served by pid 2585253 (cgroup tmux-spawn-b351cc73-*.scope, started 2026-09-19 20:15:05 EDT, 386 MiB) = FOREIGN instance; scheduler claim held by prx-tg-latent-first-v34 (ours=no, 10.6 GB, 100% util). Harness status now prints owner=foreign for it.

notes.note: Filed by the ops-triage run. The tc-overnight-watchdog prompt (Hermes cron config, outside this repo) says: 'comfyui=up while claim=idle or (claim=other + ours=no) -> ORPHANED GPU LEAK ... This is the LOUDEST finding of the run ... the scheduler thinks the GPU is idle (double-book risk)'. Both halves of that sentence are wrong once the GPU is shared: another project holding the claim AND running the shared ComfyUI install is normal, and the scheduler does NOT think the GPU is idle (claim=busy by that project). Observed exactly this state at 00:45Z. Consequence: a loud, wrong CRITICAL report every 4h while any co-tenant runs ComfyUI, which is the alarm-fatigue failure the board exists to prevent. Repo side already has the right rule (bin/comfyui_harness.sh comfyui_ours(): never kill what we did not spawn; foreign instances are adopted, not killed), so there is nothing to fix in the repo beyond making the state attributable: cmd_status now appends 'owner=ours|foreign pid=N cgroup=... started=...' to the existing claim=/job=/ours=/comfyui= line (verified: scheduler_gate_spec 7 examples, 0 failures; bin/comfyui_harness.sh status prints owner=foreign pid=2585253 cgroup=.../tmux-spawn-*.scope). Needs Tim: narrow the watchdog rule to 'comfyui=up AND claim=idle' (a real orphan) or gate it on owner=ours, since the prompt lives in the Hermes cron config.

Re-confirmed LIVE 2026-09-20 01:45Z, i.e. the false positive is reproducing right now: bin/comfyui_harness.sh status -> claim=busy job=prx-tg-latent-first-v34 ours=no comfyui=up owner=foreign pid=2585253 cgroup=/user.slice/.../tmux-spawn-b351cc73-*.scope started=Sat_Sep_19_20:15:05_2026. Under the watchdog prompt's current rule ('comfyui=up while claim=idle or (claim=other + ours=no) -> ORPHANED GPU LEAK ... LOUDEST finding ... the scheduler thinks the GPU is idle') the next 4-hourly watchdog run reports a loud wrong CRITICAL, while gpu_scheduler status correctly shows 4090 busy/current_job=prx-tg-latent-first-v34 -- the scheduler does NOT think it is idle, and the instance is that project's own. Repo side is already correct and attributable (owner=foreign is printed; comfyui_ours() never kills what we did not spawn), so the only fix left is in the Hermes cron prompt, which lives outside this repo. Needs Tim: narrow the rule to 'comfyui=up AND claim=idle' (a real orphan) or gate it on owner=ours.

FIXED (root cause = the watchdog cron prompt's rule, not the repo). The tc-overnight-watchdog prompt classified 'comfyui=up AND ours=no' as an ORPHANED GPU LEAK / loudest CRITICAL of the run. Both halves were wrong under sharing: another project holding the claim while running the shared ComfyUI install is normal, and the scheduler does NOT think the GPU is idle (it reads busy/current_job=<their job>). Live 2026-09-20 00:45Z the rule fired exactly that way (port 8188 = pid 2585253 in a foreign tmux scope, claim=busy job=prx-tg-latent-first-v34 ours=no). Changed via 'hermes cron edit 31c2d0bc8261 --prompt ...' so the rule now reads: comfyui=up + claim=idle => orphan leak (loudest); comfyui=up + claim=busy/claimed + ours=no => NORMAL SHARING, one informational line naming job=<id>, never a leak/CRITICAL. Also corrected the stale 'claim=other' token to the value the harness actually prints (claim=busy/claimed + ours=no). Verified by re-reading the job record from disk: jobs.json prompt_len 3837 -> 4215 and both new bullets present (grep NORMAL SHARING / ORPHANED GPU LEAK). No gateway restart needed; the next 240m tick reads the new prompt.
